summary: Shard assignment is drawn from the global RNG.
true_fix: Assign shards by a stable hash of the item -- e.g. `zlib.crc32(item.encode()) % shard_count` -- or take an injected `random.Random` the caller seeds.
nondeterminism_source: `random.randrange` draws from the process-wide RNG, seeded from the OS at startup, so the layout differs on every call.
masking_fix: Call `random.seed(0)` in the test. The assignment becomes repeatable for the test only; production stays unbalanced.
